**FOR FUTURE REFERENCE**
**For any given year the only changes needed are the new 538 file, dat25 becomes dat~CURRENT_YEAR~ throughout, and regional for loop must be altered to represent the regions including the first four matchups. Everything else is seamless in theory.**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Load dataset with corrected path
dat <- read_csv("madness2025.csv")

# Ensure numeric calculations apply correctly to probability columns
probability_cols <- c("rd1_win", "rd2_win", "rd3_win", "rd4_win", "rd5_win", "rd6_win")
dat25 <- dat

dat25[probability_cols] <- dat[probability_cols] / dat[probability_cols]

# Display the first few rows to verify data
dat25 %>% head()
```

### Tournament Simulation Function

```{r}
tournament_simulation <- function(data) {
  data <- data %>% arrange(desc(rd1_win))
  
  # Example: Simulate round 1 winners (more detailed logic may be needed)
  data$winner <- ifelse(runif(nrow(data)) < data$rd1_win, 1, 0)
  
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
# Run a basic simulation
simulated_data <- tournament_simulation(dat25)
head(simulated_data)
```
